## Responsibility

The `openapi` contract kind of the system map (F7, design/08). `ContractDetector` finds OpenAPI 3 and Swagger 2 specifications (YAML or JSON) with their title, version and servers for `system discover`. It decides nothing about applications or consumers; that is core's discovery.

## Invariants

- Only a top-level `openapi: 3.x` or `swagger: "2.0"` makes a specification [[cite: packages/plugin-openapi/src/openapi-contract-detector.ts:28 | "if (!/^(3\\.|2\\.0)/.test(String(version))) return ok(undefined);"]].
- A file that does not parse is not a specification, never an error [[cite: packages/plugin-openapi/src/openapi-contract-detector.ts:24 | "return ok(undefined); // not YAML or JSON: not a specification"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `yaml`. No other plugin; runtime wires it.

## Pitfalls

- A Swagger 2 specification has no `servers`: the server is built from `schemes`, `host` and `basePath`.
